text:
Nora (People Ops): quick one  Claire is US-based but currently in London for 2 weeks. Can we do I-9 with an authorized rep there or do we wait until she's back?
Raj (HR): short answer: remote hires can use an authorized representative to complete Section 2, but we need the signed delegation form and a photo of their ID + the rep's ID. also must be recorded in the file.
Tom (Hiring Manager): Claire's rep is her partner and works at a co-working office. Is that allowed?
Nora (People Ops): allowed. we send the "I-9 Authorized Rep" PDF and the checklist to Claire. Rep must sign and we capture the rep's contact info + a photo of the physical docs.
Claire (New Hire): I can do that. How do I get the delegation form to them?
Nora (People Ops): i'll DM the PDF and link. steps we follow:
```
1) Claire signs delegation form and emails to people-ops@redwood.example with cc to the rep.
2) Rep completes Section 2 in-person, takes photo of each doc front/back.
3) Claire uploads photos to secure intake AND attaches rep's completed form.
4) HR scans & stores in BambooHR under I-9 docs.
```
Onboard Bot: reminder: Section 2 must be completed within 3 business days of start date. If not, employee is flagged contingent.
Raj (HR): also, because Claire's role is security-sensitive, we require an additional identity verification call (10 min) with Security Ops when rep signs.
Security Ops: we can do a short verification and confirm the rep's ID matches the photos. we'll join the 15:30 BST slot if that's what you schedule.
Tom (Hiring Manager): Claire's start is Mon 2026-04-06. That puts the 3-business-day window into that Friday. Claire, can the rep do Section 2 on Tue?
Claire (New Hire): yes, rep available Tue 2026-04-07 11:00 BST. I'll email the signed form today.
BadgeBot: badge request queued. Note: physical badge pickup requires original ID check on site. If rep picks up, we need rep authorization on file.
IT: provisioning note: laptop imaging scheduled Day 1 AM. Access to internal entitlements (prod) will be gated until background check completes. Standard apps + Slack granted.
Nora (People Ops): BG vendor (ClearTrace) needs Claire's e-sign consent. Claire, did you receive that?
Claire (New Hire): i saw an email but didn't click the link yet. Is this urgent?
Raj (HR): yes, consents must be in before vendor runs checks. If consent isn't provided within 48h pre-start, the check will be delayed. Please complete ASAP.
Claire (New Hire): done just now. link worked. thanks.
Onboard Bot: background-check status: CONSENT_RECEIVED (1785004400). Vendor ETA: 72 hours.
Nora (People Ops): one more wrinkle: ClearTrace flagged a county fingerprint backlog for remote hires from this region last week. If fingerprinting is needed, that could add 5-7 business days. We'll mark role as "sensitive" and restrict credential issuance until cleared.
Tom (Hiring Manager): ok to proceed with onboarding sessions and benefits enrollment in the meantime?
Raj (HR): benefits enrollment is fine. payroll will set the hire date as scheduled. only security-sensitive accesses are blocked until BG clear.
IT: confirmed. we'll issue laptop and standard corp email; disable admin groups until BG cleared. We'll add a "bg-pending" tag to the account.
Nora (People Ops): action items: 1) I send I-9 delegation PDF + checklist to Claire now. 2) Claire emails signed delegation + rep contact. 3) Security Ops schedules 10-min verification during rep meeting. 4) Claire completes BG consent (done). 5) BadgeBot will await rep auth for pickup.
Claire (New Hire): thanks everyone  I'll email the signed form in 10 minutes and confirm the Tuesday slot for the rep.
Tom (Hiring Manager): i'll attend the security call if needed. excited to have Claire onboard! :party_parrot:
Onboard Bot: thread closed when BG status == CLEARED. Current status: CONSENT_RECEIVED.
Nora (People Ops): logging note in Claire's onboarding task: "I-9 via authorized rep (London), security verification scheduled, BG consent received, badge pending rep auth."
